description: Pattern-based prevention rules for GlitchDungeon — Godot 4 GDScript regression detection (35 files)

rules.name: Non-deterministic seed using wall-clock time
rules.message: Daily dungeon seed uses wall-clock time — non-deterministic, all players get different dungeons
rules.suggestion: Use deterministic date-based seed: var seed: int = hash('%d-%02d-%02d' % [year, month, day])

rules.name: Texture shared between NPC and enemy scenes
rules.message: NPC scene references enemy texture — visual confusion for players
rules.suggestion: Create dedicated NPC sprites; do not reuse enemy textures for friendly NPCs

rules.name: AudioStreamPlayer without stream resource
rules.message: AudioStreamPlayer node may have null stream — no audio files found in project
rules.suggestion: Create assets/audio/ directory and assign stream: $AudioStreamPlayer.stream = preload('res://assets/audio/sfx.ogg')

rules.name: Time.get_unix_time_from_system() in game logic
rules.message: Time.get_unix_time_from_system() returns non-deterministic wall-clock time — use deterministic alternatives
rules.suggestion: Use Time.get_date_dict_from_system() for daily seeds, or Engine.get_process_frames() for timing

rules.name: Hardcoded enemy stats instead of Resource files
rules.message: Hardcoded enemy stat — use Resource (.tres) files for data-driven enemy definitions
rules.suggestion: Create EnemyStats resource: var stats: EnemyStats = preload('res://resources/enemies/skeleton.tres')
